sentences.en: Peter Goodman on why, this time, none of those tools seem to be working.
sentences.zh: 彼得·古德曼将为我们解析，为什么这一次，所有这些工具似乎都失效了。

sentences.zh: 你们俩能跟我讲讲你们的一天吗？

sentences.en: Oh, wow.

sentences.zh: 所以学校停课了。

sentences.en: And then.
sentences.zh: 然后呢。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.zh: 然后我们去操场玩了，大概整个下午都在那儿。

sentences.zh: 所以我想问你们一个问题。

sentences.en: What do you know about the coronavirus?
sentences.zh: 你们对冠状病毒了解多少？

sentences.zh: 中国，然后现在它在很多地方都有，比如英国、意大利，嗯，还有中国，显而易见。

sentences.en: Then it's also in Japan, Korea.
sentences.zh: 然后它也在日本、韩国。

sentences.en: Yeah.

sentences.en: No.

sentences.zh: 好吧，这就是为什么我们想和你们的父亲彼得·古德曼谈谈。

sentences.en: So do you, do you think I could speak to him now?
sentences.zh: 所以你们觉得，我现在可以跟他说话吗？

sentences.en: Okay.

sentences.zh: 谢谢你们。

sentences.zh: 嘿，彼得。

sentences.en: Hey, Michael.
sentences.zh: 嘿，迈克尔。

sentences.en: You have adorable children.
sentences.zh: 你有可爱的孩子们。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: And they have a very significant understanding of the coronavirus, a little less so the stock market.
sentences.zh: 他们对冠状病毒有相当深入的了解，对股市的了解则少一些。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Well, you know, I don't have to manage my portfolio just yet.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你知道的，我暂时还不需要管理我的投资组合。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So Peter, let's start with what happened on Thursday morning.
sentences.zh: 那么彼得，让我们从星期四早上发生的事情开始说起。

sentences.en: Welcome back.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回来。

sentences.en: The markets just opened now down 1,600, 1,642 points.
sentences.zh: 市场刚刚开盘，目前下跌了 1,600 点，下跌 1,642 点。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Well, what happened on Thursday morning was the markets opened.
sentences.zh: 嗯，星期四早上发生的事情是市场开盘了。

sentences.en: Trading was open for about five minutes and you can see down almost 2,000 points in that amount of time.
sentences.zh: 交易仅仅进行了大约五分钟，你可以看到在那么短的时间内就下跌了将近 2,000 点。

sentences.en: And immediately plummeted by 7%.
sentences.zh: 并且立即暴跌了 7%。

sentences.en: There's the circuit breaker, 25, 49, 48 and the bell.
sentences.zh: 出现了熔断机制，25、49、48 和钟声。

sentences.en: So we'll wait here.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这里等待。

sentences.en: We'll suspend trading for 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们将暂停交易 15 分钟。

sentences.en: Oh, we got 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们有 15 分钟时间。

sentences.en: And we'll see what happens after that.
sentences.zh: 然后我们将看看会发生什么。

sentences.en: Which trips a so-called circuit breaker that stops trading.
sentences.zh: 这触发了所谓的熔断机制，从而停止了交易。

sentences.en: Now, let me tell you how big 7% is.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我告诉你 7% 的幅度有多大。

sentences.en: On a normal day, in a normal time of trading, a 1% move is significant.
sentences.zh: 在正常日子、正常的交易时间内，1% 的变动就很显著了。

sentences.en: That tells you that something significant has happened either on the upside or the downside.
sentences.zh: 这告诉你，无论是上涨还是下跌，都发生了重大的事情。

sentences.en: We will see 2% and even
sentences.zh: 我们会看到 2%

sentences.en: 3% moves, but that's a very big deal.
sentences.zh: 甚至 3% 的变动，但那已经是件非常大的事了。

sentences.en: Through this recent period of panic, we've seen 4% and 5% moves, which have dominated headlines.
sentences.zh: 在最近这段恐慌期，我们看到了 4% 和 5% 的变动，这些都占据了新闻头条。

sentences.en: That's told us that there's serious agitation in the market.
sentences.zh: 这告诉我们，市场存在严重的动荡。

sentences.en: We know that Asian markets have sold off dramatically.
sentences.zh: 我们知道亚洲市场已经大幅抛售。

sentences.en: We know that European markets have sold off dramatically.
sentences.zh: 我们知道欧洲市场已经大幅抛售。

sentences.en: And New York opens and immediately straight down 7%.
sentences.zh: 而纽约开盘，随之直接直线暴跌 7%。

sentences.en: There's fear in the market.
sentences.zh: 市场中弥漫着恐惧。

sentences.en: By the end of the day, stocks were down by roughly 10% in New York, 5% plus across Europe.
sentences.zh: 到一天结束时，纽约的股票下跌了约 10%，整个欧洲则下跌了 5% 以上。

sentences.en: And it was the worst wealth destruction in one single day since 1987.
sentences.zh: 这是自 1987 年以来单日最严重的财富毁灭。

sentences.en: It was worse than anything we saw in the dot-com bubble.
sentences.zh: 这比我们在互联网泡沫时期看到的任何情况都要糟糕。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It was worse than any day we saw during the global financial crisis of 2008 and
sentences.zh: 这比我们在 2008 年全球金融危机期间看到的任何一天都要糟糕，并且

sentences.en: So tell me about that fear that you're describing.
sentences.zh: 所以跟我讲讲你所描述的那种恐惧。

sentences.en: What did we learn from the Thursday morning crash in the markets?
sentences.zh: 我们从周四早上的市场暴跌中学到了什么？

sentences.en: We learned that things were even worse than we thought.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到情况比我们想象的还要糟糕。

sentences.en: And we learned that the usual tools that are used in a time of an economic shock are basically inoperative in this crisis.
sentences.zh: 并且我们了解到，在经济冲击时期使用的常规工具在这场危机中基本上失效了。

sentences.en: And Peter, why would that be?
sentences.zh: 彼得，为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Why would the tools that we have used for decades in financial crises not apply here?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们在金融危机中使用了几十年的工具在这里不适用了？

sentences.en: Well, how much time have you got?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你还有多少时间？

sentences.en: 25 minutes.
sentences.zh: 25 分钟。

sentences.en: So I think it's useful to think about the unfolding pandemic in three stages.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得分三个阶段来思考正在展开的大流行病会很有用。

sentences.en: And the first stage, of course, is in central China,
sentences.zh: 而第一阶段，当然是在中国中部，

sentences.en: China in the city of Wuhan in Hubei province, which is known as something like China's Detroit.
sentences.zh: 中国湖北省武汉市，这里被称为中国的底特律。

sentences.en: There's a lot of auto factories there, auto parts factories, a lot of electronics are made there.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多汽车工厂、汽车零部件工厂，很多电子产品在那里制造。

sentences.en: It's a major industrial hub.
sentences.zh: 它是一个主要的工业中心。

sentences.en: And it's in early January that it becomes clear that Wuhan has got a major problem and is really shut down.
sentences.zh: 正是在 1 月初，人们变得清楚地意识到武汉遇到了重大问题，并且实际上已经封城了。

sentences.en: And so economists wake up to the reality that this is going to be an economic shock.
sentences.zh: 因此，经济学家们意识到这将是一场经济冲击。

sentences.en: China is the source of roughly one third of all growth in the global economy.
sentences.zh: 中国大约占全球经济所有增长的三分之一。

sentences.en: It's such a significant part of the world economy that if China is having a tough time, the world is having a tough time.
sentences.zh: 它是世界经济中如此重要的一部分，以至于如果中国日子不好过，世界日子就不好过。

sentences.en: But at this point in January, we're hearing that we can expect disruption to the so-called global supply chain.
sentences.zh: 但在一月份的这个时刻，我们听到的是我们可以预料到所谓的全球供应链会受到干扰。

sentences.en: All of these factories in Wuhan and the surrounding areas are shut down.
sentences.zh: 武汉及周边地区的所有这些工厂都关闭了。

sentences.en: Eventually, factories are shut down in places like Shanghai, Guangdong, major industrial areas.
sentences.zh: 最终，上海、广东等地的工厂也关闭了，这些都是主要的工业区。

sentences.en: And the world is braced to discover that electronics, auto parts, plastic,
sentences.zh: 世界正准备发现，电子产品、汽车零部件、塑料、

sentences.en: I mean, all sorts of piece parts of industry that are exported around the world and put into finished products are likely going to be short.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，各种各样的工业零件，这些零件被出口到世界各地并组装成成品，很可能会出现短缺。

sentences.en: And then some very large companies like Apple Computer, which makes lots of their products in China and also sells a lot of their products in China,
sentences.zh: 然后一些非常大的公司，比如苹果电脑，它们的大量产品在中国制造，同时也大量在中国销售产品，

sentences.en: they start warning that sales are going to disappoint for the first quarter of the year.
sentences.zh: 它们开始发出警告称，今年第一季度的销售额将令人失望。

sentences.en: They warn that they may have difficulty getting their goods made.
sentences.zh: 它们警告说，它们的商品制造可能会遇到困难。

sentences.en: General Motors, which now sells more cars in China than in the United States.
sentences.zh: 通用汽车目前在中国销售的汽车比在美国还要多。

sentences.en: It's clear that their earnings are potentially troubled.
sentences.zh: 很明显，它们的收益可能会受到困扰。

sentences.en: And then the shortage of parts begins to ripple out at first just in Asia.
sentences.zh: 然后零部件短缺开始蔓延，起初只在亚洲。

sentences.en: So Hyundai, the major Korean automaker, has to shut down auto production at their factories in South Korea as they're unable to get parts that are made in Chinese factories.
sentences.zh: 因此，韩国主要汽车制造商现代汽车不得不关闭其在韩国工厂的汽车生产，因为他们无法获得在中国工厂制造的零部件。

sentences.en: Same thing happens to Nissan at their plant in Japan.
sentences.zh: 日产在其日本工厂也遇到了同样的情况。

sentences.en: But at this point, it's clear that this is a significant story because China is so significant that any slowdown in China is going to ripple through the region.
sentences.zh: 但此时，很明显这是一个重大的故事，因为中国太重要了，中国的任何放缓都会在整个地区产生连锁反应。

sentences.en: But there's still this sense that people who are worried about the economic impacts are saying, yeah, this is going to be bad for a few months.
sentences.zh: 但人们仍然有一种感觉，那些担心经济影响的人说，是的，这会在几个月内变得糟糕。

sentences.en: And then we will see fairly rapid recovery because, you know, if Apple can't make your iPad in January, they'll make it in April when people can safely get back to work.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会看到相当迅速的复苏，因为，你知道的，如果苹果在一月份无法制造你的 iPad，当人们能够安全地回到工作岗位时，他们会在四月份制造。

sentences.en: So the conventional wisdom is this is going to be bad for China.
sentences.zh: 因此，传统观点认为这对中国来说将是糟糕的。

sentences.en: It's potentially going to be bad for the global supply chain.
sentences.zh: 它可能对全球供应链不利。

sentences.en: But then everything will snap back.
sentences.zh: 但随后一切都会迅速反弹。

sentences.en: But that changes in the middle of
sentences.zh: 但这在

sentences.en: February when suddenly there are significant numbers of cases in Italy.
sentences.zh: 2月中旬发生了变化，当时意大利突然出现了大量病例。

sentences.en: And that's when we entered the second stage of this economic crisis connected to the spread of this virus.
sentences.zh: 正是在那时，我们进入了与这种病毒传播相关的这场经济危机的第二阶段。

sentences.en: And what defines the second stage?
sentences.zh: 而第二阶段的定义是什么？

sentences.en: Well, we learn that it's a lot bigger than China.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我们了解到这比中国要大得多。

sentences.en: Italy's government has overnight announced a massive shutdown across the country as it struggles to cope with coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 意大利政府在一夜之间宣布在全国范围内进行大规模封锁，因为它正艰难应对冠状病毒。

sentences.en: Officials in Italy now say that five people have died from the virus there.
sentences.zh: 意大利官员现在表示，已有五人死于该病毒。

sentences.en: The number of cases in that country has risen to 219 very quickly.
sentences.zh: 该国的病例数迅速上升至 219 例。

sentences.en: Now we learn that there are significant numbers of cases in Italy and they are shutting down a significant part of Italian industry.
sentences.zh: 现在我们得知，意大利出现了大量的病例，并且他们正在关闭意大利工业的很大一部分。

sentences.en: About 16 million people in northern Italy will be placed under a travel ban for a month.
sentences.zh: 意大利北部大约一千六百万人将被实施为期一个月的旅行禁令。

sentences.en: It's the toughest attempt to contain the virus outside of China.
sentences.zh: 这是中国境外遏制病毒最大胆的一次尝试。

sentences.en: And the first time such a measure has been taken in Europe in centuries.
sentences.zh: 这也是几个世纪以来欧洲首次采取此类措施。

sentences.en: This is the industrial heartland of Italy.
sentences.zh: 这里是意大利的工业心脏。

sentences.en: It's responsible for about 40 percent of the country's annual economic output.
sentences.zh: 它承担了该国大约百分之四十的年度经济产出。

sentences.en: There are a lot of auto parts factories there.
sentences.zh: 那里有许多汽车零部件工厂。

sentences.en: And a lot of multinational companies with factories both in China and Italy had been ramping up production in Italy to try to compensate for shortages in China.
sentences.zh: 许多在中国和意大利都设有工厂的跨国公司一直在意大利加紧生产，试图弥补中国的短缺。

sentences.en: And now they have to shut down.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们不得不关门停产。

sentences.en: So interestingly, Peter, this virus seems to first hit the Detroit of China and then basically the
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，彼得，这种病毒似乎首先袭击了中国的底特律，然后基本上是

sentences.en: Detroit of Italy.
sentences.zh: 意大利的底特律。

sentences.en: Two major centers of manufacturing are basically being shut down.
sentences.zh: 两个主要的制造中心基本上都在关停。

sentences.en: These are two economic centers.
sentences.zh: 这两个都是经济中心。

sentences.en: And as economic centers, you have lots of people coming and going through these places.
sentences.zh: 作为经济中心，有大量人员在这些地方进进出出。

sentences.en: So as the epidemic starts spreading rapidly in Italy, it's both a signal that the global economic effects are much bigger than we initially feared.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着疫情在意大利迅速蔓延，这既是一个信号，表明全球经济影响比我们最初担心的要大得多。

sentences.en: But also the public health crisis is bigger.
sentences.zh: 但公共卫生危机也更大了。

sentences.en: If there are lots of cases growing dramatically in Europe, and these are democracies.
sentences.zh: 如果欧洲的病例大量急剧增长，而且这些都是民主国家。

sentences.en: So the sorts of draconian measures that were used quite effectively to choke off the spread of the virus in China, that's not going to work in Italy.
sentences.zh: 因此，在中国用来相当有效地遏制病毒传播的那种严厉措施，在意大利是行不通的。

sentences.en: That's probably not going to work in
sentences.zh: 这在

sentences.en: France or Spain or Portugal or the UK.
sentences.zh: 法国、西班牙、葡萄牙或英国可能也行不通。

sentences.en: So the markets absorb the fact that this is not a China story, which was already enough to spook markets.
sentences.zh: 因此，市场意识到这不是一个中国的故事，而这已经足以让市场感到恐慌了。

sentences.en: This is a global story.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全球性的故事。

sentences.en: And that's when the markets start to get very volatile.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，市场开始变得非常动荡。

sentences.en: The markets are now dealing with the fact that there are lots of things that they don't know.
sentences.zh: 市场现在要应对的是，有许多未知的事情。

sentences.en: And the imagination is now going to dark places.
sentences.zh: 人们的想象力现在开始转向黑暗的方面。

sentences.en: And just to practically explain what's happening in these moments when the stock market is plunging
sentences.zh: 为了切实解释在股市暴跌

sentences.en: and then recovering and then plunging as the coronavirus is spreading, people are just starting
sentences.zh: 然后回升，接着随着新冠病毒蔓延而再次暴跌的这些时刻正在发生什么，人们只是开始

sentences.en: to sell stocks in all the companies that have operations in these countries or that they fear might be impacted by problems in those countries.
sentences.zh: 抛售所有在这些国家有业务的公司的股票，或者他们担心会受到这些国家问题影响的公司的股票。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Well, the companies that are most directly on the line, they're suffering the moSt. So, you know, autos, airlines, of course, because flights are being shut down, hotels, leisure,
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些首当其冲的公司受到的打击最严重。所以，你知道的，汽车、航空公司，当然还有因为航班停飞而受影响的酒店、休闲度假、

sentences.en: restaurants.
sentences.zh: 餐饮业。

sentences.en: I mean, these sorts of companies are seeing their stock values go down.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这类公司的股票价值正在下跌。

sentences.en: But as Italy gets worse, and as the global supply chain becomes a story, and as everybody gets nervous about the extent
sentences.zh: 但随着意大利的情况恶化，随着全球供应链成为热门话题，随着每个人都对我们现在所说的大流行病的严重程度感到紧张，

sentences.en: of what we now describe as a pandemic, markets move into a phase where they just, investors want to get rid of anything that looks risky.
sentences.zh: 市场进入了一个阶段，投资者只想摆脱任何看起来有风险的东西。

sentences.en: They want to sell all stocks, and they want to take their money and put it into a sure thing.
sentences.zh: 他们想抛售所有股票，把资金转移到稳妥的项目上。

sentences.en: And the entire stock market begins to look like a dangerous place to be.
sentences.zh: 整个股市开始显得危机四伏。

sentences.en: Which brings us to stage three of this crisis.
sentences.zh: 这就把我们带到了这场危机的第三阶段。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁版？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Well, economic fears over the coronavirus outbreak are manifesting into action.
sentences.zh: 好吧，对新冠疫情爆发的经济担忧正在转化为实际行动。

sentences.en: Yesterday, the Federal Reserve slashed interest rates by half a percentage point on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 昨天，美联储在周二将利率大幅下调了半个百分点。

sentences.en: It's all an attempt to give the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了给美国

sentences.en: economy a shot in the arm.
sentences.zh: 经济注入强心剂。

sentences.en: So, Peter, what does stage three of this crisis look like?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，这场危机的第三阶段是什么样的？

sentences.en: The first thing that happens is the U.S.
sentences.zh: 首先发生的是美国

sentences.en: Federal Reserve, this is the central bank, steps in in early March, and they cut interest rates pretty dramatically.
sentences.zh: 美联储，即中央银行，在三月初介入，他们相当大幅度地降息。

sentences.en: It was also an unscheduled cut.
sentences.zh: 这也是一次非例行的降息。

sentences.en: So they have a meeting in two weeks, but they felt it was necessary to act now.
sentences.zh: 所以他们本该在两周后开会，但他们觉得有必要现在就采取行动。

sentences.en: This is an emergency action to encourage commercial activity, to borrow money, to spend money, to invest, to make the economy move.
sentences.zh: 这是一项紧急行动，旨在鼓励商业活动、借贷、消费、投资，以推动经济运转。

sentences.en: And that's supposed to provide some relief.
sentences.zh: 这本应提供一些缓解。

sentences.en: Stock markets love it when interest rates go down.
sentences.zh: 股市喜欢降息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Only in this case, it doesn't work out like that.
sentences.zh: 唯独这一次，事情并非如此发展。

sentences.en: Why not?
sentences.zh: 为什么不呢？

sentences.en: So initially, markets respond the way they're supposed to.
sentences.zh: 所以最初，市场的反应正如预期那样。

sentences.en: I mean, investors on cue say, aha, the Fed has lowered rates.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，投资者顺应形势说，啊哈，美联储降息了。

sentences.en: That's good news for stocks.
sentences.zh: 这对股市是个好消息。

sentences.en: People are going to buy, so they buy.
sentences.zh: 人们会买入，所以他们买入了。

sentences.en: And then very soon thereafter.
sentences.zh: 然后很快就在那之后。

sentences.en: A volatile session on Wall Street today.
sentences.zh: 今天华尔街经历了动荡的一交易日。

sentences.en: The markets were down, then they were up, then they were down again.
sentences.zh: 市场先是下跌，然后上涨，接着又下跌。

sentences.en: So let's take a look.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看。

sentences.en: The markets plunge again.
sentences.zh: 市场再次暴跌。

sentences.en: 793 points lower on the Dow today after the Fed cut rates this morning because of the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 由于新冠病毒，美联储今天上午降息后，道指今天暴跌了793点。

sentences.en: And Peter, why would that be?
sentences.zh: 彼得，这到底是为什么呢？

sentences.en: Why would cutting interest rates, which is a time-tested financial solution in a crisis, not work here?
sentences.zh: 为什么在危机中历经考验的金融解决方案——降息，在这里不管用了？

sentences.en: Why were investors, as you said, seeing through it as ineffective?
sentences.zh: 为什么投资者正如你所说的那样，看穿了它的无效性？

sentences.en: Because this crisis is unusual.
sentences.zh: 因为这场危机很不寻常。

sentences.en: Now, it's useful to think about the economy in terms of the demand side and the supply side.
sentences.zh: 现在，从需求端和供给端来思考经济是很有用的。

sentences.en: Yeah, explain.
sentences.zh: 是的，请解释一下。

sentences.en: Yeah, so let's pretend that the entire global economy is a big shopping mall.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么让我们假设整个全球经济是一个大型购物中心。

sentences.en: The supply side is all the stuff that ends up in the shops at the mall.
sentences.zh: 供给端就是最终摆在商场店铺里的所有商品。

sentences.en: The demand side is you.
sentences.zh: 需求端就是你。

sentences.en: You show up at the mall.
sentences.zh: 你来到了商场。

sentences.en: You're interested in buying a new iPad.
sentences.zh: 你有兴趣买一台新iPad。

sentences.en: Maybe you need a new pair of running shoes, whatever.
sentences.zh: 也许你需要一双新跑鞋，诸如此类。

sentences.en: How flush are you feeling?
sentences.zh: 你现在手头有多宽裕？

sentences.en: That's the amount of demand in the economy.
sentences.zh: 这就是经济中的需求量。

sentences.en: Well, the central bank and the traditional economic playbook can deal with the demand side.
sentences.zh: 嗯，中央银行和传统的经济对策可以应对需求端。

sentences.en: It can put more money in your pocket, maybe through a tax cut, maybe through a lowering of interest rate,
sentences.zh: 它可以通过减税，或者通过降息，把更多的钱放进你的口袋，

sentences.en: which makes you feel better about running up a credit card balance or financing in some fashion.
sentences.zh: 这会让你对透支信用卡或以某种方式融资感觉更好。

sentences.en: So it can put you in the mood to go spend more.
sentences.zh: 所以它可以让你产生去更多消费的心情。

sentences.en: It can boost demand.
sentences.zh: 它可以刺激需求。

sentences.en: The traditional playbook can't do much, if at all, about a supply shock.
sentences.zh: 对于供给冲击，传统的对策起到的作用微乎其微，甚至毫无作用。

sentences.en: And what we have now is a supply shock.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在面临的就是供给冲击。

sentences.en: We have a situation where the iPads aren't showing up at the mall because the factories in China are shut down and they're not making them.
sentences.zh: 我们遇到了这样一种情况：iPad没有送到商场里，因为中国的工厂都关门了，无法生产。

sentences.en: There aren't flights that are connecting China to the rest of the world.
sentences.zh: 没有航班连接中国和世界其他地方。

sentences.en: Truck drivers are afraid to haul their freight across borders because they're worried about getting sick.
sentences.zh: 卡车司机害怕跨国运送货物，因为他们担心生病。

sentences.en: So the Fed can drop interest rates all at once and it doesn't touch that supply side problem.
sentences.zh: 因此，美联储可以一次性大幅降息，但它根本触及不到那个供给端的问题。

sentences.en: Moreover, there is on top of this a significant demand side problem.
sentences.zh: 此外，除此之外还有一个非常严重的需求端问题。

sentences.en: You may not want to go to the mall, even if you are flush, even if there is an interest rate cut, even if there is a targeted tax cut that encourages you to go shop.
sentences.zh: 你可能不想去商场，即使你手头宽裕，即使有降息，即使有鼓励你去购物的定向减税政策。

sentences.en: And you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: The government probably doesn't want you to go right now either because policy is mostly properly centered on how do we prevent people from contracting a lethal virus.
sentences.zh: 政府现在可能也不希望你去，因为政策的核心正确地放在了如何防止人们感染致命病毒上。

sentences.en: So that means that this traditional playbook of central banks dropping interest rates,
sentences.zh: 这意味着中央银行降息、

sentences.en: governments using their budgetary power to spend money in a way where they try to spur economic activity.
sentences.zh: 政府利用预算权力花钱以刺激经济活动的传统对策，

sentences.en: Most of that stuff just doesn't work in this situation.
sentences.zh: 其中大部分在这种情况下根本不管用。

sentences.en: And that's what the markets have been discovering.
sentences.zh: 这就是市场一直在发现的情况。

sentences.en: And it's filled them with fear.
sentences.zh: 这让他们充满了恐惧。

sentences.en: It's given them a sense that companies are being hit by this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 这让他们觉得企业正受到这场大流行病的打击。

sentences.en: It's going to hurt their earnings.
sentences.zh: 这将会损害它们的收益。

sentences.en: It's going to make stock values go down.
sentences.zh: 这会导致股票价值下跌。

sentences.en: And there just isn't much that the authorities can do about that.
sentences.zh: 而当局对此确实无能为力。

sentences.en: So normally when the Federal Reserve Bank cuts interest rates or Congress cuts taxes or the White House pumps money into the economy, it puts cash into people's pockets.
sentences.zh: 所以通常情况下，当美联储降息、国会减税或白宫向经济注资时，它会将现金放入人们的口袋。

sentences.en: But if there's less to buy and people don't even want to leave their houses to go buy those things, then having more money in your pocket, it doesn't really solve the problem.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果可买的东西变少了，人们甚至不想离开家去买这些东西，那么口袋里有更多的钱，并不能真正解决问题。

sentences.en: That that's right.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: What the Fed is essentially doing is knowing that their tools don't really work.
sentences.zh: 美联储本质上是在明知他们的工具并不真正管用的情况下，

sentences.en: They're using whatever tools they've got.
sentences.zh: 使用他们手头仅有的任何工具。

sentences.en: They're giving us a demonstration of their willingness to jump in and do something extraordinary.
sentences.zh: 他们向我们展示了他们愿意介入并做出非凡举动的意愿。

sentences.en: And the markets divine from that, that the Fed is really worried, that things are worse than we thought, that, sorry to use another metaphor,
sentences.zh: 市场从中推断出，美联储真的很担忧，情况比我们想象的还要糟糕，抱歉再用一个比喻，

sentences.en: it's as if the Fed is saying the world's on fire, except the traders see that the fire department doesn't have any water.
sentences.zh: 这就好像美联储在说世界着火了，但交易员们却发现消防部门根本没有水。

sentences.en: And this is a realization that is not restricted to the United States.
sentences.zh: 这种认识并不局限于美国。

sentences.en: The Bank of England drops rates the following week significantly.
sentences.zh: 英国央行在接下来的一周大幅降息。

sentences.en: The European Central Bank steps up their bond purchases a couple of days after that, which is a way of driving down interest rates.
sentences.zh: 欧洲央行在此之后几天加大了债券购买力度，这是压低利率的一种方式。

sentences.en: And in both of those cases, stock markets globally plummet,
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，全球股市都暴跌，

sentences.en: and it becomes abundantly clear that investors are concluding that all of this action is just revealing the impotence of the tools in this particular instance.
sentences.zh: 并且变得非常清楚，投资者得出的结论是，所有这些行动只是暴露了这些工具在特定情况下的无能。

sentences.en: So, Peter, does that mean that we're basically kind of stuck right now, economically speaking, through this pandemic?
sentences.zh: 那么，彼得，这是否意味着从经济角度来看，我们在这场大流行病期间基本上有点被困住了？

sentences.en: Or are there things that governments in the U.S., in Europe, in Asia can do to try to basically stabilize the economy for the next few weeks and months?
sentences.zh: 还是说美国、欧洲、亚洲的政府可以采取一些措施，在未来几周和几个月内基本上稳定经济？

sentences.en: Well, it's going to be very difficult for governments to stabilize the economy.
sentences.zh: 嗯，政府要稳定经济将非常困难。

sentences.en: But there are lots of things that governments can and should be doing to diminish the pain for the people who are caught in harm's way.
sentences.zh: 但政府可以也应该做很多事情，来减轻那些陷入困境的人的痛苦。

sentences.en: I mean, people are losing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，人们正在失业。

sentences.en: Companies are going to fail.
sentences.zh: 企业将会倒闭。

sentences.en: There's going to be a lot of economic pain, and people are going to have a hard time paying their bills.
sentences.zh: 将会出现大量的经济痛苦，人们将很难支付账单。

sentences.en: That's the time where governments step in with things like this expanded sick pay policy that's being discussed in the States and in Europe and in the U.K.
sentences.zh: 这个时候政府就会介入，采取诸如美国、欧洲和英国正在讨论的这种扩大带薪病假政策的措施，

sentences.en: So that when people can't get to their jobs, they don't find themselves without paychecks.
sentences.zh: 这样当人们无法去上班时，他们不会发现自己没有了薪水。

sentences.en: This is a time for expanded unemployment benefits.
sentences.zh: 这是扩大失业救济的时候。

sentences.en: This is a time to boost health care systems so that we have the capacity to treat people.
sentences.zh: 这是加强医疗保健系统以使我们有能力治疗病人的时候。

sentences.en: The problem is that while all that stuff should happen and some of it is happening,
sentences.zh: 问题是，尽管所有这些事情都应该发生，且其中一些正在发生，

sentences.en: it doesn't address the fundamental reality that this crisis is beyond the traditional tools that we have at our disposal to tame an economic crisis.
sentences.zh: 它并没有解决这样一个根本现实：这场危机超出了我们处置经济危机的传统工具的范畴。

sentences.en: This is a public health emergency.
sentences.zh: 这是一场公共卫生紧急事件。

sentences.en: People are dying.
sentences.zh: 人们正在死亡。

sentences.en: Policy is appropriately focused on limiting the spread of this virus, which, by the way, is what's best for the global economy.
sentences.zh: 政策正适当地集中在限制这种病毒的传播上，顺便说一句，这才是对全球经济最好的做法。

sentences.en: The global economy is going to continue to feel pressures to see businesses in trouble so long as there is legitimate fear about the spread of this pandemic.
sentences.zh: 只要人们对这场大流行病的蔓延存在合理的担忧，全球经济就将继续感受到压力，看到企业陷入困境。

sentences.en: There's no getting around the fact that the only way to try to limit the spread of the virus is to do further damage to the economy.
sentences.zh: 无可否认的事实是，试图限制病毒传播的唯一方法就是对经济造成进一步的损害。

sentences.en: When we cancel trade shows, when we close schools, when we tell people to stay in their homes,
sentences.zh: 当我们取消贸易展、关闭学校、告诉人们呆在家里，

sentences.en: when we frighten people by telling them that they should not go to restaurants or bars or movie theaters or see concerts and we ban public gatherings, we limit spending.
sentences.zh: 当我们通过告诉人们不应该去餐馆、酒吧、电影院或看音乐会来吓唬他们，并且禁止公众集会时，我们限制了消费。

sentences.en: We shrink the size of the economy.
sentences.zh: 我们缩减了经济规模。

sentences.en: And that's what's happening.
sentences.zh: 这就是正在发生的事情。

sentences.en: That's appropriate, because if we don't do that, this pandemic is going to kill a lot of people and do economic harm.
sentences.zh: 这是适当的，因为如果我们不这样做，这场大流行病将杀死很多人并造成经济危害。

sentences.en: So the only way to deal with the threat to the economy is to get our arms around the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 因此，应对经济威胁的唯一方法是控制住大流行病。

sentences.en: And the only way to do that is to accept that we're inflicting more harm on the economy.
sentences.zh: 而这样做的唯一方法是接受我们正在对经济造成更多损害这一事实。

sentences.en: Peter, thank you.
sentences.zh: 彼得，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, the Federal Reserve cut interest rates to near zero and said it would spend hundreds of billions of dollars to stem the economic damage from the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，美联储将利率下调至接近零的水平，并表示将花费数千亿美元来遏制大流行病造成的经济损失。

sentences.en: In a statement, its leaders said, quote,
sentences.zh: 在一份声明中，其领导人表示：

sentences.en: The Federal Reserve is prepared to use its full range of tools to support the flow of credit to households and businesses.
sentences.zh: 美联储准备动用其全部工具箱，以支持向家庭和企业发放信贷的流动性。

sentences.en: But the impact of those actions remains uncertain.
sentences.zh: 但这些举措的影响仍然存在不确定性。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, a growing number of local and federal officials in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周末期间，美国越来越多的地方官员和联邦官员

sentences.en: and across the world advised citizens to stay home and avoid public places,
sentences.zh: 以及世界各地建议公民留在家中，避免前往公共场所，

sentences.en: grinding economic activity in multiple industries to a near halt.
sentences.zh: 这使得多个行业的经济活动几乎陷入停滞。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他消息。

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the United States expanded its travel ban to the United Kingdom and Ireland,
sentences.zh: 周末期间，美国将旅行禁令扩大到英国和爱尔兰，

sentences.en: barring citizens of both countries from traveling to the United States to avoid spreading the coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 禁止两国公民前往美国，以防止冠状病毒传播。

sentences.en: That ban now applies to 28 different European countries.
sentences.zh: 该禁令现在适用于28个不同的欧洲国家。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, to assess the health of those entering the U.S.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，为了评估从欧洲入境美国的人的健康状况，

sentences.en: from Europe, the Trump administration imposed new screening measures, creating chaotic scenes at multiple airports where wait times for the screenings lasted up to eight hours.
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府实施了新的筛查措施，导致多个机场出现混乱场面，筛查等待时间长达八小时。

sentences.en: In Europe, France and Spain ordered much of their countries shut down.
sentences.zh: 在欧洲，法国和西班牙下令关闭国内大部分地区。

sentences.en: Spain instructed all residents to remain indoors, with few exceptions, while France closed all restaurants, cafes, and non-essential businesses.
sentences.zh: 西班牙要求所有居民除少数例外情况外必须待在室内，法国则关闭了所有餐馆、咖啡馆和非必需品企业。

sentences.en: As of Sunday, the coronavirus has infected nearly 160,000 people worldwide and killed about 6,000.
sentences.zh: 截至周日，冠状病毒已在全球感染了近16万人，并造成约6000人死亡。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: This is something that is of great consequence.
sentences.zh: 这是一件极其重大的事情。

sentences.en: This is like a war.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一场战争。

sentences.en: And in a war, you do whatever is needed to be done to take care of your people.
sentences.zh: 而在战争中，你会不惜一切代价照顾好你的人民。

sentences.en: During Sunday night's Democratic debate, hosted by CNN and Univision, both Joe Biden and Bernie Sanders attacked President Trump's handling of the coronavirus as inadequate
sentences.zh: 在周日晚间由美国有线电视新闻网（CNN）和西班牙语电视网（Univision）主办的民主党辩论中，乔·拜登和伯尼·桑德斯都抨击特朗普总统对冠状病毒的处理不力，

sentences.en: and said they would call on the military to help contain the disease.
sentences.zh: 并表示他们将动员军队来协助控制疫情。

sentences.en: The vice president just mentioned war.
sentences.zh: 副总统刚才提到了战争。

sentences.en: Would you deploy to U.S.
sentences.zh: 你会部署美国

sentences.en: military in effort to contain the virus?
sentences.zh: 军队来努力控制病毒吗？

sentences.en: And if so, how?
sentences.zh: 如果是的话，会怎么做？

sentences.en: Well, I think we use all of the tools that make sense.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为我们会动用所有合理的工具。

sentences.en: And if using the National Guard, which is folks, I think, in New York State already using the National Guard, that is something that has to be done.
sentences.zh: 如果动用国民警卫队——也就是那些人，我认为纽约州已经动用了国民警卫队——这是必须要做的事情。

sentences.en: The debate was held without a studio audience to minimize the risk of transmission.
sentences.zh: 为了将传播风险降到最低，辩论在没有现场观众的情况下举行。

sentences.en: And the candidates avoided a customary handshake as they walked on stage, bumping elbows instead.
sentences.zh: 候选人走上舞台时避免了惯常的握手，而是改用碰肘替代。

sentences.en: The next primaries will be held tomorrow in states including Florida, Arizona, and Ohio.
sentences.zh: 明天的初选将在佛罗里达州、亚利桑那州和俄亥俄州等州举行。

sentences.en: That's it for today.
sentences.zh: 今天就到这里。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个受严密控制的机器运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天。

sentences.en: When elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 当时选举迎来了一批自称为改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱有时又令人兴奋的权力争夺战中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在由我莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《都市》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却最终失控的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《都市》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
